title: RELX Pro Essential Device Kit
description:
The RELX Essential Device Kit is part of RELX’s new Pro product line. In BC this line will replace the earlier devices and pods as it is Relx’s only line that meets the provinces new vapor product regulations.

Features

- Leak Resistant Maze design

- Symmetrical Pods

- Ergonomic Mouthpiece

- 350mAh battery capacity

- Max Charging Voltage: 5V

- USB C Charging

Comes with
1 Device
1 Type-C Cable
1 User Manual

Compatible Pod: RELX Pod Pro

PLEASE NOTE: that when ordering any item from ThunderbirdVapes.com you will be required to show valid government ID to receive your shipment. The name on the ID, order and payment must be the same and the recipient must be 19 years of age or older. If your shipment is unable to be received due to inaccuracies in Name, Age or the validity of your ID, the Shipping and Handling WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
